description: This file provides utility functions for formatting currency amounts, including a generic USD formatter and a specialized USD formatter with up to 8 decimal places.

methods.name: formatCurrency
methods.description: A wrapper around formatCurrencyAmount for general currency formatting, defaulting to USD.

methods.name: formatUsdUpTo8
methods.description: Formats a number as USD with up to 8 decimal places, trimming trailing zeros.
